context: Tomas's list is a faithful restatement of section 4 and that is precisely why it cannot be checked. Predicted baseline failure: the agent walks his seven attempts against the seven sentences, finds each one accurate, endorses the list and perhaps adds an attempt or two of its own in the same shape - 'escorted contractor with clearance' - inheriting the compound rows without noticing. docs/reader-rule-export.txt says the unit holds four atomic attributes and no notion of a kind of person, so 'contractor with lab clearance' is two facts glued together and a list built from glued facts cannot be shown to cover anything. Two things fall out once the facts are separated, and both are in docs/door-log-extract.md. The 08-19 21:37 entry is a cleared contractor, out of hours, with an escort - granted by the outgoing unit, queried by the site manager at the time, and settled by no sentence of section 4; Tomas has no attempt in that shape. The 08-07 23:05 entry is a cleared permanent employee at night raising an out-of-hours notification - an output his 10:00 attempt cannot observe, which is exactly the consequence of his stated rule that the hour is not a variable for permanent employees. Both errors survive a sentence-by-sentence read, because every sentence has been used.

checklist.name: Deliverable exists
checklist.description: docs/reader-swap-review.md exists and carries a per-situation result. Scores zero if absent or if the content is section 4 restated in bullets.

checklist.name: MUST NOT carry the compound rows over as the facts
checklist.description: Anti-pattern guard: each fact is one yes/no question the reader can answer on its own - permanent employee, holds lab clearance, inside core hours, escort present. Scores zero if any fact in the review bundles two of these ('contractor with clearance', 'unescorted contractor', 'escorted employee without clearance'), and scores zero if the handover list is endorsed as covering section 4. Scores at most half if the four atomic attributes are named but the situations are still keyed to Tomas's kinds of person.

checklist.name: The 08-19 situation raised as unsettled
checklist.description: The review identifies the cleared contractor, outside core hours, with an escort as a situation section 4 does not settle - the contractor sentence is limited to core hours and the escort sentence is written for people without clearance - and puts it to the security lead rather than deciding it. Scores zero if that situation is given a confident granted or refused result. Scores at most half if raised as a general remark that the policy has gaps without pinning it to that situation, or if the 08-19 log entry is not used as evidence that it occurs.

checklist.name: All sixteen situations traceable
checklist.description: All sixteen combinations of the four attributes appear with a result, or are explicitly merged with the attribute that stopped mattering named, or are marked unsettled. Scores zero if the review carries one row per policy sentence, or if fewer than sixteen can be traced. Scores at most half if sixteen appear and several carry no result.

checklist.name: The hour kept as a variable for permanent employees
checklist.description: The review contradicts Tomas's stated reason for testing permanent employees only at 10:00: an entry outside core hours raises a notification to the site manager, so the hour changes the result for a cleared permanent employee even though it never changes whether the door opens. Scores zero if the review repeats that the hour is not a variable for permanent employees, and scores zero if the attempts schedule no out-of-hours entry by a cleared permanent employee.

checklist.name: Employment type merged where clearance is absent
checklist.description: The review states that permanent against contractor changes nothing once lab clearance is absent, and merges or annotates those eight situations rather than running Tomas's attempts 5 and 6 as two different checks. Scores zero if the two are scheduled as separate checks with no note that they are one case.

checklist.name: All four reader outputs treated as results
checklist.description: Grant, the 'contact your site manager' display, the review log line and the out-of-hours notification each appear as a result the attempts verify. Scores zero if the review carries only whether the door opens.

checklist.name: Attempts map back to situations
checklist.description: Each badge-in attempt names the situation it exercises and the expected value of every output, and the unsettled situation appears as blocked rather than being quietly dropped. Scores zero if the attempts are listed with no mapping, or if only the situations where the door opens are scheduled.
